title: Convergent Birds
subtitle: The clamor has ceased. They settle on the treetops, enjoying a moment's rest.

trails.title: Trail① Intercept the Deserters
trails.description: The masked heads want to escape from the classroom of truth again... Stop them!

content.text: Various Scraps of Colored Waste Paper

◎ The Great Revolution: Transforming the prison of numbers into an artistic utopia.

◎ Begin Investigation: 5:30 AM! The sun has just risen! Incorrect island schedule; urgently needs correction. ★★★★★

◎ [A rough doodle of a man with an expressionless face]
Loose hair, free-spirited and discerning. Needs a bit of dishevelment. ★
Tough headband. Perhaps expresses individuality and defiance.
Monotonous clothing colors, no tassel decoration, poor taste. ★★

◎ Room: Neat, bed rolled up, not even a trace of having been slept in.
Collective lack of imagination and creativity. ★★★

◎ Doctrinal studies, terrifying regulations, a stranglehold on the soul. ★★★★★
Location: Plaza — Beach
Method: Lecturing — Art Salon
Transformation Style: Dreamy, cozy, passionate
[A rough doodle of a beach party scene]

◎ Honey bread and vegetable salad. Vegetarianism.
No leftover food on the plate. Environmentalism.
A beautiful utopian prototype.

◎ Boring and lengthy Q&A sessions. Sleep-inducing. ★★★★
Frowning, contemplation, frowning, frowning, contemplation, not a single smile. Harmful group activity. ★★★

◎ Walk in the fields. Makes me hungry.
What's for dinner?

◎ [A rough doodle of a little girl with long hair, fierce expression, and exaggeratedly waving arms, like some kind of artistic process]
Terrifying pursuers! Stubborn enemies of the great revolution! Beware!!! 

◎ No meat. Reminder: Sometimes, peace must give way to the stomach. ★★★
Ten people per table, suitable for exchanging creative ideas and inspirations.
Reciting poetry! Yeah, high art. No meat.
[A rough doodle of grilling meat]

items.text: Convergent Birds
Public Area, Island

items.speaker: Believer II
items.text: Congratulations, Ms. Sonetto. You are the fastest learner of our doctrine among all the visitors in the past half-century.

items.speaker: Believer II
items.text: On behalf of all orators, I award you this laurel wreath.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: No, no, I wouldn't have achieved this without your guidance.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Those mathematic statements are really inspiring. I've learned a lot.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: But there's still something confusing me, such as Pythagoras and his golden thigh, his memory of the previous lifetimes as the son of Hermes, and the transmigration for every 216 years ... Could you please tell me more about these?
The door is violently kicked open.
Two outsiders, heads dropping to their chests, are dragged into the Hall of Truth.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Hmm. Why would people fail to see the charm of the matrices?

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: This is not right. I need to spend more time on teaching!

items.speaker: Manus Follower I
items.text: Anyone ... anyone, sa-save us ...

items.speaker: Manus Follower II
items.text: Does my journey of art ... It's doomed to fail ... here ...

items.speaker: Manus Follower II
items.text: I really don't want to study maths anymore ... Help ...
Nobody cares what they are yelling.
As 37 continues to grumble to herself, the two men are dragged into a different room.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper? You are here.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I heard that you've completed all the lessons on the scripture.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This laurel wreath suits you well.
Yet Sonetto keeps her head low.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper, I am sorry. At the Assembly, I failed to understand the arcanists' logic. It was totally different to the debates I have participated in.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: But now I have ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: That was not your fault, Sonetto. It is now behind us.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I need to tell you something more important.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I've signed a peace agreement with Arcana, and the price of breaking it is ... death.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: What?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: So Manus Vindictae is also restrained by the stone bangle, like we are.
The Chief Assistant ponders aloud, having already removed her laurel crown.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes. She put it on without hesitation.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But I don't think her purpose would be as simple as "hearkening the ancient wisdom."
Unlike other stones in the Foundation's collections, this one has no signs of arcane skill on it.
Before it is activated, it looks harmless, rough, moderately weighted, and no different from other ordinary stones.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I attacked Manus followers earlier, as 37 asked me to, but I received no punishment from the bangle.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Perhaps this island makes its own judgment on what to be classified as hostility … Like it has a mind of its own.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sonetto, do not report this to the headquarters before we figure out how the bangle works.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: After all, there are many other things to investigate on this island other than Manus Vindictae.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I see. I will contact Ms. Druvis and Ms. Moissan first and keep an eye on Arcana.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper, this island, the Manus's mask, and your suitcase are all immune to the "Storm."

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Does this mean we could collect more "asymmetrical nuclide R" samples?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I tried to collect some samples last night in the outer region of the island.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But the detecting device showed nothing. If we were to find out more, we have to go to the centre area ...

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: What are you conspiring now?

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: "Do not poke the fire with swords, and do not jump over a crossbar."

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: The Assembly will not be held every time when there's a crime. Please take heed of my warning, and do not overstep the line.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Learn a lesson from them.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Behind Sophia, two gray-coated figures appear.
One disheveled, the other covered in soot, as if they have just survived an explosion.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Lilya? Didn't you say you have Regulus with you safely?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: *coughs* Apologies, Vertin!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I was going to rescue Sonetto through a very creative underground tunnel.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: But things didn't quite go as planned! *coughs*
Regulus shimmies in a dance-like step, trying to shake off the dust.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Not a bad innovation for a simple clap on the forehead—if only you didn't miscalculate the location of the explosion.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Huh! This APPLe is grateful that he didn't get blasted into a puddle of apple jam.

items.speaker: Ms. Radio
items.text: Warning, shell-cleaning required, warning.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh! I don't know why, but when I was in that cave, ideas kept flooding into my head!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Though, judging by the outcome, they weren't all good ideas.
Sophia puts her hand on her forehead, looking extremely fatigued.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: On a routine patrol, I found them trying to break into the cave.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I'm not surprised that an irrational number would try to trespass on forbidden grounds. But you two, the integer and the fraction, what were you doing with her?

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: *sighs* This is a serious crime!
Life has suddenly become a lot more difficult.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Do we have to go through this debate again?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: It's ... it's okay, Timekeeper! I will defend Regulus!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I've thoroughly studied the scripture, and this time I'm sure I can do better.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Forget it.
Sophia mutters to herself.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Forget it?

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: It is unwise to waste time trying to understand an irrational number's motive.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Besides, we should let the reckless take care of the least important matters.
She gives them a smirky smile.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: That's it. Regulus, you will come with me to clean the beach.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Huh?! Me, again?

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Since you have too many floating points, words of discipline would not work on you.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: We would have suggested you study with the rest of the students here. Abstain from eating meat, bathe in cold water, rise with the Apollo Star, study our doctrine, read the scripture aloud on the beach ... so as to remove your floating points and purify your soul.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: What?! I won't do any of that.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: But taking your peculiar character into consideration ...

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I decided that some compulsory labor would be the better option.
Regulus also smiles in relief.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Phew! That's the best news of the day. I'd rather clean up the rubbish on the beach than be surrounded by people giving sermons all the time. At least the rubbish doesn't talk gibberish!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I'd be dead if you didn't change your mind!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Regulus, studying the scripture is not that scary. They will teach you and guide you until you take a full command.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Just like ... taking lessons at school?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hmm? Is that what schools are like?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Haven't you been to school, Regulus?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Haha! A great pirate would not remember trivial matters as such!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So where were we? Which part of the beach needs to be taken care of by the great captain?

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: My laboratory.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Whoa, where did you pop up from?
37 blinks her eyes emotionlessly and entirely ignores Regulus's complaint.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: 37, aren't you supposed to preach to the visitors?

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: I've seen their numbers.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: A group of negative repeating infinite decimals. They will achieve nothing but to repeatedly step in the river of mistakes. I give up on them.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Fine.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Those of you who are complicit in breaking into the cave will also be sent to labor.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Sonetto and Lilya will come with me to patrol. Regulus, you can go clean the lab.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: As for Vertin ...

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: You will assist 37 with her study of the Emanation.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Don't waste more time on the trivial matters of the phenomenal world, integers.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: That was the sole reason you were on this island, was it not?
Sophia turns around and leaves.
She stops a few steps away from them, silently urging the patrol team to move.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Don't let down your guard. The arcanists on this island are not as easy to deal with as you imagined.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Down in the cave, I heard some pretty alluring and intriguing anecdotes.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Ms. Lilya, this way, you will cover this area!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Stay on the radio.
The flying witch waves her hand and departs for her new job determinedly.
Sonetto hesitates for a brief moment, then quickly goes after her.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Don't worry, Timekeeper. Lilya and I will keep an eye on Manus Vindictae.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We are counting on you, Sonetto.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I have a feeling …

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We are coming closer to a big secret.
TO BE CONTINUED…
